# Han Park Design

> Official portfolio of Han Park (박한결), a graphic designer based in Seoul, South Korea.

Han Park is a graphic designer with 4+ years of professional experience. He helps brands build demand through graphic design, creative direction, performance marketing, and DTC e-commerce, with a focus on growing K-beauty brands in North America.

## Core information

- Name: Han Park
- Korean name: 박한결
- Title: Graphic Designer
- Location: Seoul, South Korea
- Primary expertise: Graphic Design
- Additional expertise: Creative Direction, Performance Marketing, DTC E-commerce, K-beauty
- Selected clients: Olive Young, Mediheal
- Recognition: 2023 Red Dot Award Winner — Brand & Communication Design
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/hanparkdesign/
- Email: hanparkdesign@gmail.com
